description.value: Mount 7 Lodges is a collection of three private luxury wilderness chalets perched above Golden, BC, offering 360-degree views of the Canadian Rockies and Purcell Mountains. The property sits near Kicking Horse Mountain Resort in one of BC's premier outdoor adventure towns, making it a natural base for exploring the region. Each self-contained lodge sleeps between two and eight guests, with one lodge (Red Fox) designed to universal accessibility standards.
